verdict.rationale: The only scheduling evidence is the MCP follow-up workflow, which can "send when each recipient is most likely to open it" (superhuman-docs-25, superhuman-docs-31). That is AI-timed delivery through an AI assistant, not a documented user-chosen send-later feature in the mail client. Nothing in the pack covers undoing a send within a grace window. Missing for 10: documented user-controlled schedule-send in the client, any undo-send or grace-window capability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
